new_public_evidence.source: Adamskiy, Koolen, Chernov, Vovk, A Closer Look at Adaptive Regret
new_public_evidence.result: Restart- and specialist-based adaptive-regret constructions both lead to Fixed Share; a reactive restart layer is not automatically a stronger tracking mechanism.

new_public_evidence.source: V'yugin, Online Aggregation of Unbounded Signed Losses Using Shifting Experts
new_public_evidence.result: Mixing Past Posteriors can be combined with AdaHedge's adaptive learning rate while retaining shifting-expert regret in an adversarial setting, giving direct precedent for replacing hard eta restarts with a theorem-matched changing-rate tracker.

new_public_evidence.source: Chugg, Wang, Ramdas, A Unified Recipe for Deriving (Time-Uniform) PAC-Bayes Bounds
new_public_evidence.result: Time-uniform PAC-Bayes via supermartingales applies to nonstationary, non-iid stochastic processes and is a clean framework for a path-uniform variance-inference layer.

new_public_evidence.source: Seldin et al., PAC-Bayes-Bernstein Inequality for Martingales and its Application to Multiarmed Bandits
new_public_evidence.result: Variance-sensitive PAC-Bayes concentration for interdependent martingales is explicitly applicable to importance-weighted sampling.

new_public_evidence.source: Howard et al., Time-uniform, nonparametric, nonasymptotic confidence sequences
new_public_evidence.result: Empirical-Bernstein confidence sequences provide an anytime-valid route that can exploit the very small paired-difference variation observed in the current rare-event abstraction.

derived_results.claim: Fixed eta/alpha within each event-time epoch preserves the exact r114 pathwise bound at a data-dependent epoch endpoint. Summing epochs gives a valid changing-eta restart certificate with explicit per-epoch C/eta+Delta terms.

Reactive restart/downshift cannot retroactively enforce a fixed global certificate budget because spent certificate remains and each fresh epoch adds ln(J)/eta_next. For B=25/9, J=3 and eta={16,8,4,2,1}, fresh prior costs alone sum to 5.91267 variance units before Delta/stay leakage.

In 200 recurring synthetic replicates, a B(C0/eta+Delta)>2.5 restart/downshift threshold worsened standard proxy-noise=1 variance by +0.15736 units on average, but improved proxy-noise=3 by -0.22506 and proxy-noise=4 by -0.17039. The certificate is therefore not a universal drift/harm statistic.

Naively confidence-bounding event-time losses targets S/(B*r_failure), not S/B: conditional on failure, E[l_j]=S_t(q_j)/(B*r_t(q_t)). The pathwise online-learning compression is valid, but true-variance inference must be built in raw time or with an explicit hazard correction.

A fixed prior over expert labels indexed by failure count remains data-independent; at raw time t it induces the predictable comparator j_{N_{t-1}+1}. This preserves event-count switch complexity while enabling raw-time martingale/PAC-Bayes inference.

The correct inference primitive is the paired raw-time difference d_t=h_t-l_t(path), because its conditional mean is the weighted candidate-vs-comparator second-moment gap and convexity upper-bounds the actual proposal-mixture gap. In 100 standard recurring synthetic runs, mean predictable quadratic variation was only 0.21460 and mean observed sum d^2 was 0.21805 over about 231.7 failures, with mean maximum predictable difference width 0.50417. This makes a variance-adaptive paired PAC-Bayes/Bernstein layer substantially more promising than two independent confidence bounds.

A two-layer engineering controller that runs eta-specific Fixed Share instances {16,8,4} from the same full-information failure losses and mixes their proposal distributions with a defensive meta Fixed Share stayed close to the better eta across abrupt, gradual and proxy-degradation tests, but currently lacks a composed theorem and did not beat eta=16 on recurring standard-noise data.

engineering_update.scope: Synthetic proposal-control results only; theorem-level results are the stopped-epoch pathwise accounting, the global-budget impossibility for reactive restart, the event-time estimand correction, and the event-index prior construction. The final paired empirical-Bernstein/PAC-Bayes-Bernstein constants remain open.

negative_or_scope_evidence: Certificate-triggered hard restarts can worsen benign regimes even when they help degraded proxy regimes.
The restart certificate is an accounting guarantee, not an automatic hard global budget or harm detector.
Event-time loss compression must not be confused with event-time conditional unbiasedness for raw second moment.
The hierarchical eta meta-controller is an engineering candidate only until a two-layer regret-to-variance theorem is written.

Uniform true-variance inference for a retrospectively selected switching comparator path is unfinished; generic Hoeffding treatment is likely too loose, so paired variance-adaptive concentration is the main route.
Dependent/systematic resampling, random particle counts, environment-transition proposal bias, and real agent trajectories remain untested.
frontier: Instantiate a theorem-matched adaptive-learning-rate shifting-expert controller, prioritizing MPP/Fixed Share plus AdaHedge-style results, and compare its exact regret term and synthetic variance against eta=16 without hard restarts.

Build the raw-time paired-difference martingale over a fixed failure-index path prior and derive an anytime PAC-Bayes-Bernstein or empirical-Bernstein upper confidence bound on cumulative true second-moment excess for all switching paths simultaneously.
Exploit predictable per-path difference ranges or observed quadratic variation so the inference layer reflects the synthetic paired variation (~0.215) rather than the generic [-1,1] range.
Derive a composed two-layer regret certificate for the hierarchical eta-meta controller and test broader proxy-noise/drift families.
If a hard certificate budget is required, formalize finite preallocated epoch budgets and an explicit stop/degrade-safe action on exhaustion; do not claim restart erases spent certificate.
Extend proper weighting and paired-difference inference to dependent/systematic sibling resampling and random particle counts.
Only after theorem-clean raw-time inference, build the judge-guided proposal plus sparse high-fidelity truth agent-evaluation proof-of-concept.
